title: Introducing Command Center
format_note: One screen-capture session of a Harvey admin dashboard: ask an AI a question, get a deck, enable a feature. Opens on a title poster, ends on a tagline card.
one_thing: Command Center is where a firm sees its Harvey usage and asks the product questions about it, with a deck produced from the answer.

transcript.voice_style: No speech. Whisper returned only 'Music' for the whole runtime; all meaning is carried by the interface text.
transcript.script_shape: The typed prompts and the assistant's replies are the script: question, answer with numbers, follow-up, generated deck, then one-click feature enablement.

structure.frame0: Pale grey poster: 'Command Center' in heavy sans centred, four floating dashboard cards (bar charts, a 305 active-users area chart, a releases card) around it (f0001.jpg, strips/window-01-0s.jpg).
structure.first_3s: Title is sharp by 0.23 s and the cards slide in by 0.77 s, then the whole poster dims through black from about 2.4 s to 3.0 s (strips/window-02-2.466s.jpg).

beats.what: Title poster with four floating dashboard cards
Fades up on a zoomed dashboard; cursor presses Explore analytics (f0003.jpg)
Camera pulls back to the full app window; Explore your analytics panel with four suggested prompts
Camera pushes into the composer; question typed: What use cases is my team using Harvey for?
Generating insights steps, then a reply: Document Review and Due Diligence (23.1% of queries), 42,610 queries
Panel closes; cursor hovers chart bars and the line chart, dark tooltips show Your firm against Peer firms
Panel reopens; second prompt typed: create a presentation for the most effective use cases based on usage in M&A
Harvey is working; Assessing query steps; a pptx pane opens with an H loading mark
Eight-slide deck renders in the pane: title slide, usage chart, activity totals, weekly users; the pane scrolls
Back to the dashboard; cursor on '15 recommended actions to increase your usage'
Recommended actions page scrolled in; cursor moves to Enable on Web search
Spinner modal, then a green check: Web search succesfully enabled, with Skip and Add users
Modal dismissed; app dims and fades to white
White end card: AI Tailored for Law, Harvey wordmark below

hero_moment.what: The generated deck appears in the pane beside the chat: a dark green title slide, Showcasing Whitford Lane's usage in M&A (f0025.jpg, about 48 s).

ending.what: Fade through white to a plain card: serif tagline centred, Harvey wordmark at the bottom, no button, no URL (f0039.jpg).

rhythm.how_change_is_paced: One 36.5 s shot (46% of runtime, 29.13 to 65.63 s) holds the whole demo; change comes from typed text, chart hovers, panels opening and camera push-ins, not cuts. No burst of cuts exists (metrics.json bursts is empty).

look.ground: Dark olive-black painted texture behind a bright off-white app window; the title poster and end card use flat pale grey and near-white grounds.
look.accent_use: Almost none: green appears only for percentage deltas, the success check and the generated slide; the black Explore analytics and Enable buttons are the only high-contrast controls.
look.type: Heavy grotesque sans for the opening title; light serif for the dashboard headings, big numbers and the closing tagline; small grotesque sans for interface labels.
look.depth: Soft drop shadows lift the floating cards on the poster; the app window sits flat on the textured backdrop with a thin rounded edge.

product_ui.camera_on_ui: Digital zoom on a flat capture: push in to a button or composer, pull back to the whole window, push in again. About six moves on one 36.5 s shot, each tied to the next click or typed line.
product_ui.notes: At full-window framing the sidebar and chart labels are about 8 px high at 720p, too small for a phone; the film zooms in for every line that matters (the prompt, the tooltips, the Enable row, the modal).

motion.text_entry: The title blurs in and sharpens in about 0.23 s (strip 01). Prompts type character by character with a caret; assistant replies stream in; step lists appear one line at a time.
motion.ui_motion: Panels slide in from the right; tooltips fade in and out on hover; the pptx pane shows a grey skeleton, then slides stack and scroll; a spinner modal resolves to a success modal.
motion.camera: Slow push-ins and pull-backs on the captured window; no rotation. The opening poster cards drift in from the frame edges over 0.77 s.
motion.eases: Camera moves ease in and out over about 1 s (strip 03, 4.0 to 4.6 s). Fades through black and white run about 0.6 s (strip 02, strip 34).

transitions.cause: Poster dims through black into the product at 3.0 s; app dims and fades to white at 74.6 s.
Zoom to the composer so the typed prompt is readable, then back out when the reply arrives.
Cursor click on Enable triggers spinner, then success modal.
Modal and dim overlay vanish between 73.533 and 73.567 s after Skip is clicked.

copy.holds_vs_reading_rule: The tagline (4 words) needs 0.5 + 1.2 = 1.7 s and holds about 2.7 s, so rule 2 is met; the long reply text at 18 s is never meant to be read in full.

sound.music: Music only, no speech. Describe tags: bowed_string_instrument 0.514, keyboard_musical 0.507, orchestra 0.482, cello 0.446, violin_fiddle 0.397, piano 0.301. No steady beat (confidence 0.01).
sound.sfx: No evidence of sound effects: the analysis lists only 11 weak spectral-flux onsets, strongest at t=0.015 s.
sound.vo_music_balance: No voiceover. Integrated -11.2 LUFS, short-term max -9, loudness range 4.5 LU.
sound.energy_arc: Six sections: A 0-20 s, B 20-27, C 27-33.5, D 33.5-45, E 45-53.5, F 53.5-78.7 s. Loudness range is narrow at 4.5 LU, so the arc is flat.
sound.sync_to_picture: Not locked: cuts_on_strong_onset_share is 0.0 against chance_share 0.003, and there is no beat grid to cut to.

good.observation: Frame 0 is a finished poster: the title sits among four floating product cards, so the subject is on screen before anything moves.
The camera zooms in to whatever the viewer must read (prompt, tooltip, Enable row, modal) and pulls back to show context, so a 720p UI stays legible without cutting.
The demo carries real numbers in the answer (23.1%, 42,610 queries) and in the generated deck (287 active users, 56,826 queries), so the claim shows output rather than naming it.
The deck rendering in the side pane is the payoff for the chat prompt: grey skeleton, then a dark green title slide, then a scroll through slides.
Restraint: one colour of backdrop, one app window, one cursor, almost no accent colour, and an end card with just a tagline and wordmark.
Every state change is caused by a visible click or keystroke: Explore analytics opens the panel, Enable spawns the spinner, Skip clears the modal.

weak.observation: No cut lands on a musical onset and the music has no beat, so the picture feels unconnected to the sound.
The audio peaks above full scale (true peak +0.2 dB, 17 clipped samples from 38.1 s) and is about 3 LU louder than the -14 LUFS social target.
At full-window framing most text is 7-8 px tall at 720p; the sidebar, axis labels and legends are unreadable at phone width.
The 36.5 s unbroken shot and the long wait for AI output (about 6 s of Harvey is working at 14-16 s and 40-44 s) slow the middle.

rule_candidates.rule: A demo film can hold one shot of 30 s or more if the camera pushes in on each line to be read (every 5-10 s) and each state change follows a click or keystroke.
rule_candidates.evidence: Longest shot 36.5 s, 46.4% of runtime; push-ins at 4, 10, 29, 66 s

rule_candidates.rule: When the product is the hero, keep the UI on screen for about 90% of runtime and open on a poster with the title and floating product cards.
rule_candidates.evidence: f0001.jpg; UI visible 3.0 to 74.6 s of 78.74 s

rule_candidates.rule: Zoom the capture so the line being read is at least about 20 px tall at 720p; pull back to the whole window only for orientation.
rule_candidates.evidence: f0007.jpg prompt text vs f0004.jpg sidebar text

rule_candidates.rule: End on a plain card: one 4-word serif tagline at about 7% of frame height and the wordmark below, held about 4 s, with no button or URL.
rule_candidates.evidence: f0039.jpg; title 52 px of 720 = 7.2%; end card from 74.6 s

rule_candidates.rule: Put one heavy-weight title at 8-9% of frame height over the first 2-3 s and swap to a lighter serif for body headings, so the opener and the product read as two typographic layers.
rule_candidates.evidence: Command Center 62 px of 720 = 8.6% (t=1.5 s); dashboard heading 15 px

rule_candidates.rule: Fade through black or white at the two seams where the film changes world (title to product, product to tagline), about 0.6 s each, and use no cross-dissolve between worlds.
Show the output of the AI feature as a rendered artefact beside the chat (a slide, a chart) with a grey skeleton first, so the viewer sees the result rather than reading the reply.
rule_candidates.evidence: f0024.jpg skeleton, f0025.jpg title slide, f0027.jpg and f0028.jpg slides

rule_candidates.rule: A music-only product film with no beat may run with zero cuts on onsets, but its loudness should still land at -14 LUFS and under -1 dBTP.
